correctness.rationale: The substitution parity recurrence forbids adjacent ones and four zeros. The exact two-phase factor decomposition is verified algebraically for every positive length. Its converse on complete rotation classes follows by parity separation of ones for all preimages of length at least two, with the singleton base handled explicitly. Odd lengths >=5 admit no fully present orbit by cyclic parity contradiction or 0000. The complete odd bases length one and three each have two classes. This proves the all-length formula and all representatives. An independently coded exhaustive finite checker tests lengths 1..192 and all 96 even-length factor decompositions, but the infinite proof does not depend on enumeration.

value.rationale: Exact Lie complexity is a motivated invariant relating cyclic factor orbits to the language and its Rauzy graphs. The structural substitution bijection provides the complete support on two geometric progressions, exactly two explicit classes at every supported length, and sharp zero elsewhere. General automaticity and the distinct cyclic-complexity formula do not calculate these parameters. The classification is infinite and explanatory rather than a routine finite table or parameter substitution.
